subject: Re: Next steps & procurement path — SOC 2 / DPA gating
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@acme.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-12T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Quick recap + next steps (Procurement path / Security items)

Hi Lina / Tom — great to meet you both today. Thanks for the time and the thoughtful questions. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum on the integration/procurement path: 

Call highlights:
- Acme is evaluating Redwood for conversational support and embeddings for search across Product & Support.
- Key procurement gating: SOC 2 report, executed DPA, and completion of your security questionnaire.
- Procurement preference: Tom indicated Acme generally prefers PO-based purchases for enterprise contracts (vs corporate card). Lina mentioned marketplace (AWS/Azure) could be an option to speed procurement if needed.

Proposed next steps (timeline):
1) I attached our SOC 2 summary and our standard DPA for your review — can you confirm which version of the DPA your legal team prefers (redline our DPA or send your template)? (Due: Sep 16)
2) Rishi to provide an architecture diagram + short security notes for your security questionnaire fields we flagged on the call. (Rishi will follow up tomorrow)
3) Procurement path — please confirm PO vs card and whether marketplace procurement is of interest; we can surface a marketplace quote if that helps shorten approval. (Tom/Lina)
4) If procurement needs an SOW or pricing letter to attach to the PO, we can provide a one-page commercial summary.

Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-Summary-2026.pdf, Redwood-Standard-DPA.docx, Vendor-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx

Let me know rough timelines from procurement/legal and we’ll prioritize.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lina Park <lina.park@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-09-13T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (Procurement path / Security items)

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few answers from the Acme procurement side:

- Procurement: we will be going via PO for anything larger than $25k/year. Smaller pilots sometimes go on corporate card, but for the initial rollout we expect PO.
- Marketplace: we are interested in the marketplace path if it reduces our procurement timeline. If Redwood can provide a marketplace SKU/quote, that could help.
- Security: procurement needs our legal team to review your DPA and SOC2 report. We typically require the full SOC 2 Type II report and the accompanying bridge letter where applicable. Can you provide the full SOC 2 Type II (PDF)?
- DPA: we prefer to redline your standard DPA. Please send the DOCX (word preferred).

Timeline: Our legal/procurement team will triage this week and aim to come back with a list of outstanding items by end of week (Sep 17). If you can send full SOC2 Type II, that would be great.

Thanks — Tom
Tom Reynolds
Procurement Manager | Acme Corp
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>, Lina Park <lina.park@acme.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-13T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (Procurement path / Security items)

Thanks Tom — attaching the SOC 2 Type II PDF and the editable DPA as requested. Rishi is cc'd and will populate the security questionnaire with the fields we can answer immediately; we expect a completed draft for you by end of day tomorrow.

Also: if marketplace procurement is helpful, we can generate an AWS Marketplace quote that aligns with the commercial terms discussed today — we’ll include that in the commercial summary if you want. Please confirm which path you prefer (PO -> Redwood direct or Marketplace).

Action items from our side: 
- I attached: Redwood-SOC2-TypeII-2026.pdf, Redwood-Standard-DPA.docx, Vendor-Security-Questionnaire.xlsx
- Rishi to follow up with questionnaire answers and short architecture note (tomorrow).
- Dylan will draft a one-page commercial summary / quote you can attach to the PO or marketplace listing.

Marissa

Attachments referenced: Redwood-SOC2-TypeII-2026.pdf; Redwood-Standard-DPA.docx
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com, legal@acme.com
Date: 2026-09-14T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA review + redlines (quick note from Redwood legal)

Hi Tom / Acme legal — looping in a brief note from our legal team. 

We’ve attached our standard DPA and are happy to accept reasonable redlines. Our typical review timeline for DPA redlines is 3–5 business days once we receive a marked-up copy; if there are material changes to indemnity or data residency requests we may need an additional business day to consult operations.

A few quick clarifications that help speed review: 
- We can sign either our DPA or your template; sending a marked-up version speeds things up.
- For SOC 2, the full Type II report is attached — if you’d like a brief call with our security lead to walk through any controls, we can schedule that this week.

If marketplace procurement is the preferred route, please indicate and we’ll prioritize the marketplace quote. Otherwise we’ll prepare the PO-supporting commercial summary.

Thanks — Neha Kapoor
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.com
From: Lina Park <lina.park@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@acme.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: 2026-09-15T10:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (Procurement path / Security items)

Marissa / Tom — thanks for the materials. We received the SOC2 Type II and the DPA docx. A couple notes from my side: 

- Procurement confirms PO route (~2–3 weeks once legal approves DPA); if Redwood can provide a marketplace quote that would likely shave off 1–2 weeks, so please do send that option.
- Legal will redline the DPA and aim to return it by Sep 17.
- For the security questionnaire, our InfoSec team will flag a couple of clarification asks; Rishi’s architecture notes will be helpful.

Appreciate the responsiveness — we’ll review and ping with next steps.

Best,
Lina Park
Sr. Program Manager, Vendor Procurement | Acme Corp
Lina.Park@acme.com
